text_10.en: A short introduction to my background in red teaming, the systems I focus on, and what this notebook is for.

text_11.en: I’m LISG, a red team practitioner with 8 years of experience. My work focuses on enterprise identity, cloud and hybrid-cloud environments, and the security of AI systems.
text_11.zh: 我是 LISG，拥有 8 年红队经验，专注于企业身份、云与混合云环境，以及 AI 系统安全。

text_13.en: I work across Active Directory and domain controller security, with a strong understanding of domains, domain trees, forests and their trust relationships. I also specialize in lateral movement across AWS, Azure, GCP and hybrid-cloud environments.
text_13.zh: 我精通 Active Directory 与域控安全，熟悉域、域树、域林及其信任关系，也精通 AWS、Azure、GCP 及混合云环境中的横向移动。

text_14.en: My areas of expertise also include large language models and the infrastructure that supports them, agent security and AI guardrails. I’m interested in how trust passes between components, particularly when model output becomes a tool call or an action.
text_14.zh: 我的专业领域还包括大模型及其基础设施、Agent 安全与 AI 围栏。我关注信任如何在组件之间传递，尤其是模型输出转变为工具调用或实际行动的时候。

text_15.en: My experience includes high-intensity adversarial engagements with AWS, Azure and GCP security expert teams.
text_15.zh: 我的经历包括与 AWS、Azure、GCP 安全专家团队开展高强度攻防对抗。

text_17.en: This notebook is a home for writing about those interests. Technical articles will be added over time; this first entry is simply an introduction to the person behind the site.
text_17.zh: 这个笔记站用于记录这些方向的思考。技术文章会在后续逐步更新；这篇开篇介绍，先让你认识网站背后的我。

text_18.en: I’m currently looking for new opportunities in red teaming, cloud security, and AI or agent security. If that overlaps with what you’re working on, feel free to get in touch.
text_18.zh: 目前，我正在寻找红队、云安全、AI 或 Agent 安全方向的新机会。如果与你正在做的事情相关，欢迎联系。
